mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emotion_record (user_id, input_text, concept_id, match_score, explanation, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{inputText}, #{conceptId}, #{matchScore}, #{explanation}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT record.id, record.user_id, record.input_text, record.concept_id, concept.name, concept.language, concept.meaning, concept.description, concept.source_url, record.match_score, record.explanation, record.created_at FROM emotion_record record JOIN emotion_concept concept ON concept.id = record.concept_id WHERE record.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY record.created_at DESC, record.id DESC
